unit_of_analysis: public web surface observed by the MAR controlled discovery protocol
selection_rule: Collect a deterministic bounded crawl from six corpora not used in the 17-unit M3 calibration set. Preserve discovery order and include eligible observed surfaces without selecting or balancing units using M3 predictions.
prediction_freeze_rule: Automatic predictions must be materialized and SHA-256 hashed before any human review unit is opened.
blinding_rule: The human reviewer must not see predicted_surface_type, predicted_item_level, prediction_confidence or prediction_evidence until the human review artifact is closed.

evaluation_plan.primary: multiclass surface-role confusion matrix and per-class precision, recall and F1 on the ecological sample
evaluation_plan.secondary: binary item-level versus non-item-level precision, recall, F1, specificity and accuracy
evaluation_plan.access_dimension: compare access-state agreement separately from semantic surface role
evaluation_plan.rare_class_policy: Classes absent or too sparse in the ecological sample will not receive generalized performance claims; a separate targeted challenge set may be created and reported separately.

stop_rule: Do not modify protocol 2.0.0 after automatic predictions are frozen. Any discovered defect after freeze is recorded as a validation finding and may only be corrected in a later protocol version.
prohibited_interpretations: the sample is not a prevalence sample
targeted challenge results, if later added, must not be pooled with ecological metrics without explicit stratified reporting
collector access failures are not scientific negatives
validation of M3 surface typing does not establish corpus membership, institutional AI use or AI participation in audiovisual content
